label: RATES_US_TREASURY_VS_STIR_SWAP_SPREAD_PROXY
floor_definition: the beta-scaled SR3 leg must remove at least 25% of unhedged ZN return variance, or the structure is not a hedged relative-value trade
what_was_computed: Leg variances and their covariance ONLY. No position was taken, no signal was scored, no return of any book was computed, and no P&L exists. This is why the gate charges zero burden: a cell that computed no return has said nothing about alpha.

construction_as_frozen_by_the_director.substrate: r41_curve_store_three_tenor_v1 (SR3 is ABSENT from the certified 68-market layer)

why_no_alpha_evidence_may_not_be_filed: The cell computed no return. Filing silence as evidence of absence is the exact mislabelling R60's director refused, and the director's R66 ruling repeats the instruction explicitly.

why_it_failed_and_why_no_re_parameterisa.the_frozen_hedge_made_the_position_WORSE: Variance reduction is NEGATIVE at -5.04%. The rolling beta is estimated on a near-degenerate leg - SR3's daily volatility is 27x smaller than ZN's - so the ratio is numerically unstable (median 15.4 SR3 per ZN) and subtracting it ADDS variance rather than removing it. The hedged position is riskier than the unhedged one.
why_it_failed_and_why_no_re_parameterisa.and_NO_hedge_ratio_could_have_passed: This is the decisive point, and it is a mathematical fact about the instrument pair rather than a property of the window chosen. For a single linear hedge the MAXIMUM achievable variance reduction is the R-squared of the regression, which is 0.1058. The floor is 0.25. No value of beta, no window length and no estimation method can reach 25% with SR3 as the hedge leg, so trying another window would not be a second chance - it would be searching for a number the data cannot produce.
why_it_failed_and_why_no_re_parameterisa.what_the_director_predicted: The ruling stated the risk exactly: ZN carries about 6.5 years of duration while SR3 is a 3-month rate future, so this is an empirical RETURN beta and not a DV01 match, and if it removed only a trivial share of variance the structure would be 'the HUMAN_GATED unconditional long-ZN book wearing a hedge as a disguise'. At a 10.6% ceiling that is what it is. Measuring it would have been measuring a blocked item under a new name.
why_it_failed_and_why_no_re_parameterisa.ZQ_is_not_a_fallback: The ruling named ZQ unauthorised in advance and gave the reason before any measurement: it is an unsecured POLICY rate, it does not express the collateral channel, and it is even less volatile than SR3. The cell is withdrawn, not re-run.

the_underlying_data_finding.statement: A genuine swap-spread or Treasury/swap trade is hedged on DV01, not on an empirical return beta. DV01 requires duration, which requires either the swap curve or the bond and contract analytics.
the_underlying_data_finding.consequence: The estate cannot construct a duration-matched fixed-income hedge for ANY structure whose legs differ materially in duration. It can only hedge like-for-like points on the same curve, where the empirical return beta happens to approximate the DV01 ratio. That is a capability limit, not an economic result, and it must never be reported as NO_ALPHA_EVIDENCE.

campaign_consequence: R66 has ZERO measured cells. r66_02 was REFUSED by the director before pre-registration as the fourth sighting of premium timing. r66_01 is WITHDRAWN at Gate A before measurement. Total burden charged by this campaign: 0. RATES_FUTURES stays at 864 and CROSS_ASSET stays at 2,448.
